high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the book "Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind" by Yuval Noah Harari. The background is black, which makes the white and orange text on the left side stand out prominently. Book Cover: The cover features the title "Sapiens" in large, bold, orange letters. Below the title, it reads "A Brief History of Humankind" in smaller, brownish text. At the top, the author's name, "Yuval Noah Harari," is written in a smaller font.
